dedupe_keys.name: hifld open us seismic ground motion hazard layers pga and spectral acceleration

description: HIFLD Open: US seismic ground-motion hazard layers (PGA and spectral acceleration) is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (U.S. Geological Survey-Geologic Hazards Science Center et al.). Uniform-hazard ground motion maps and their underlying GIS data were prepared for PGA and horizontal spectral accelerations at 0.2, 1.0, and 5.0 second period, with a probability of exceedance of 2%, 5% and 10% in 50 years, for NEHRP soil site classes B/C and D (VS30 equal to 760 and 260 m/s, respectively).Full dataset can ... Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 15 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
